The '''scout ship''' was a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] model very similar to the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]],<ref name="HeirEmpire1">[[Heir to the Empire 1|''Heir to the Empire'' 1]]</ref> but it was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The ship was used as a recon [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] by [[Thrawn's confederation]], and was in service by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] notably sent some of his operatives in a number of scout ships to conduct an [[Obroa-skai information raid|information raid]] on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai's]] [[Celebratus Archive|library]].<ref name="HeirEmpire" />
